top.line: Defining the sovereign website the way serverless was defined: owned, movable, commodity only.

in-short.line: Almost nobody searches for it; own and move; one proprietary part locks you in; seven principles; every host.

category.line: Serverless was a category before a product; agentic is how we build, sovereign is what the site is.

lockin.line: One proprietary part in the middle, however small, means nobody can move the site, even for pay.

principles.line: Own it, move it, nothing proprietary, open content and schema, anyone can change it, bounded, proven.

maturity.line: Level 0 rented to level 5 sovereign and proven; the same model inside companies and clouds.

hosts.line: The same commit on GitHub Pages, Cloudflare, Netlify, Azure, AWS, Codeberg, a European bucket, your machine.

design.line: Not plain and not small: five designs, very visual, and shops without a heavy backend.

next.line: sovereignwebsite.org for the principles, .ai for the service, a self-assessment, the every-host pipeline.

limits.line: A proposal; only GitHub Pages in use today; platform placements by their published terms.

sources.line: A search that found little, and the sovereignty, lock-in, cell and registrar pieces.
